# MCP Tools

## filler_add_fields
Add new fields to the schema

**Input:**
- `fields` (array, required) — Fields to add
  - `name` (string, required) — Unique field name
  - `description` (string, optional) — Field description
  - `auto` (boolean, optional) — Auto-fill flag
  - `instructions` (string, optional) — Instructions for auto-filling
  - `type` (string, optional) — Data type (string, number, date, etc.)
  - `example` (string, optional) — Example value

---

## filler_list_fields
List all fields or a subset by names

**Input:**
- `names` (array, optional) — Optional list of field names to filter
- `include_instructions` (boolean, optional) — Include instructions in response

---

## filler_get_objects_by_name
Get objects by their names (key field values)

**Input:**
- `names` (array, required) — Object names (key field values)
- `include_field_meta` (boolean, optional) — Include field metadata in response
- `skip_filled_fields` (boolean, optional) — Skip already-filled field values from object response
- `only_fields` (array, optional) — Only include these field names in object values (ignored when skip_filled_fields is true)

---

## filler_add_objects_by_name
Create new objects with the given names

**Input:**
- `names` (array, required) — Names for the new objects

---

## filler_save_objects_no_overwrite
Save field values for multiple objects at once without overwriting existing non-empty values. Optionally attach cell notes per field (only written when field value is saved).

**Input:**
- `objects` (array, required) — Array of objects to save
  - `name` (string, required) — Object name
  - `values` (record, required) — Field values to save
  - `comments` (record, optional) — Optional cell notes per field (only written when field value is saved)

---

## filler_get_next_missing_fields_objects
Get multiple objects that have missing auto-fill fields (batch version)

**Input:**
- `limit` (number, optional) — Maximum number of objects to return
- `include_field_meta` (boolean, optional) — Include field metadata in response
- `skip_filled_fields` (boolean, optional) — Skip already-filled field values from object response
- `only_fields` (array, optional) — Only include these field names in object values (ignored when skip_filled_fields is true)

---

## filler_use_sheet_id
Switch to a different Google Sheet by ID or URL (sheets backend only)

**Input:**
- `sheet_id` (string, required) — Google Sheets ID or full URL

---

## filler_google_auth
Authenticate to Google Sheets using device code flow. Actions: status (check auth), start_auth (get verification URL/code), complete_auth (finish auth with device_code)

**Input:**
- `action` (enum, required) — Action to perform
- `device_code` (string, optional) — Device code from start_auth (required for complete_auth action)

---

## filler_init
Initialize the current spreadsheet by creating a fields tab populated from the first tab's column headers

**Input:** *(none)*
